theme: Aureate Command Center (Premium Black + Gold Futuristic)
description: A high-end, luxury AI assistant dashboard. Blends futuristic command center aesthetics with premium fashion/luxury gold accents. Focuses on processing fluency, extreme spacing, and crystal glassmorphism.

headings.strategy: The 'Editorial Future' archetype. Wide, clean geometric sans for a sophisticated, futuristic tone. Never use Inter for headings.

body.strategy: Highly legible, geometric body font that pairs seamlessly with Outfit.

colors.strategy: Archetype 5: Luxury. Deep void black as the anchor, metallic gold as the singular focal point. No rainbow gradients, no default SaaS blues.

glassmorphism.rules: Use for the Sidebar, Top Header, and Settings Cards. CRITICAL: Never use fully transparent backgrounds where text scrolls underneath.

tracing_beam.usage: Use specifically for the prominent 'Navigation Mode' button to highlight its primary importance.
tracing_beam.style: A subtle gold gradient border that glows, combined with a hover state that lifts and brightens.

app_structure.sidebar: Hidden on mobile (use Shadcn Sheet for hamburger), visible on md+. Must have glassmorphism over any background elements.
app_structure.main_content: Flex column, full height. Contains sticky header (glass) and scrollable chat area.

spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing (2-3x normal). Use p-6 to p-8 inside cards. The chat bubbles must have breathing room (gap-6 between messages).

micro_interactions.hover: All buttons: transition-transform duration-200 hover:-translate-y-[2px] active:translate-y-0
micro_interactions.entrance: Staggered fade-up for chat list and schedule items (opacity-0 translate-y-2 to opacity-100 translate-y-0).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure gold text on white/black meets minimum 4.5:1 WCAG AA. If gold on white fails, use darker #997300.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, role-based format (e.g., data-testid='new-chat-button').

login_background.description: Abstract dark luxury gold wavy lines. Use as a full-bleed background on the Google Login screen with a glassmorphism overlay card for the login form.

icons.instructions: Use Lucide React (pre-installed). For the Navigation button, use icons like Compass or MonitorPlay.

components_instructions.Navigation_Button: Must be visually distinct from normal sidebar links. Use a gold background or gold tracing border. text-primary-foreground (black) if bg is gold.
components_instructions.Chat_Bubbles: User bubbles: flat primary or muted dark grey. AI bubbles: transparent with subtle border or glassmorphism. Add a golden subtle glow to the AI avatar icon.
components_instructions.Usage_Counter: Display prominently but elegantly in the sidebar. Example: '3 / 10 Sessions' with a thin gold progress bar.
components_instructions.Settings_Panel: Avoid card overuse. Use flat, rectangular layouts separated by delicate 1px border-white/10 lines.
components_instructions.Language_Selector: Use Shadcn Select/DropdownMenu. CRITICAL: The dropdown content must have a solid or highly opaque glass background (e.g., bg-popover or bg-black/90). NO fully transparent backgrounds.
components_instructions.Navigation_Mode_Panel: When active, split screen or prominent overlay showing the shared screen (video element) and the AI's explanation panel side-by-side or stacked on mobile.
components_instructions.Forms: Use Shadcn Input, Switch, Select for Settings and Schedules. Customize to match the Black + Gold theme (remove default blue rings, use ring-primary).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) and saturate(150%).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific properties like transform and opacity.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped or rounded-lg with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Install if not available, or use Shadcn toast.
DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds in dropdowns, headers, or overlays where content is underneath.
Update tailwind.config.js to include the defined Outfit and Manrope fonts, and custom colors.
